titles.title: A bill to authorize leases of up to 99 years for land held in trust for federally recognized Indian Tribes.
A bill to authorize leases of up to 99 years for land held in trust for federally recognized Indian Tribes.

action.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Indian Affairs.

bill.summary: This bill authorizes any federally recognized Indian tribe to lease their land held in trust for a term of up to 99 years.
